Meet Louise

Hi, I’m Louise, but most people call me Lou

I’m a health coach and mindfulness teacher on the Isle of Wight. I trained with the Institute of Integrative Nutrition, I’m a certified mindfulness teacher, and I’m a member of the Institute of UK Health Coaches.

I help busy women who always put themselves last find small, realistic ways to nourish themselves, on and off the plate. 26k people follow along on Instagram for my micro mindfulness and meditation.

Questions

Before you save your seat

I’ve never meditated. Is this for me?

Yes. Everything is short, simple and designed for complete beginners with full, busy days.

What if I can’t make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch it when it suits you.

Is this therapy or medical advice?

No. It’s an educational class with a health and mindfulness coach. It isn’t medical advice, therapy or treatment, and it doesn’t replace support from your GP or another qualified professional.

Why is it only £17?

Because the first step should be an easy one. Come along, try the practices, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each around 30 to 45 seconds, in your own voice.

Script 1 · “Not an hour”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Mindfulness doesn’t need an hour. Here’s what I mean.”

Body

“Most self-care advice asks for time busy women simply don’t have, so it ends up on tomorrow’s list. Micro mindfulness flips that. Tiny practices, one to five minutes, done often. At the kettle. In the car. Before you open your inbox.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in the Power Pause Masterclass. It’s £17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: close-up talking to camera, coral top, soft blush wall, big smile on the hook.

Script 2 · “The kettle pause”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“This is my favourite 60-second practice, and you can do it while the kettle boils.”

Body

“Feet on the floor. One hand on your chest. Three slow breaths, longer out than in. Then notice one thing you can hear. That’s a Power Pause. Small, simple, and easy to repeat every day.”

CTA

“In my live masterclass I’ll show you five more, and help you build your own routine. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: in the kitchen, kettle in frame, on-screen text “60 seconds” in Fraunces italic on a coral highlight.

Script 3 · “On and off the plate”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Looking after yourself isn’t only about what’s on your plate.”

Body

“As an Integrative Nutrition health coach, I look at the whole picture: food, rest, movement, and the little moments in between. When we only focus on one part, the rest gets forgotten. A few small pauses can bring it back together.”

CTA

“Join my live Power Pause Masterclass. Sixty minutes, £17, replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a smoothie being made, then back to camera for the CTA.
